lines.zh: 金气拖着我在半空滑行。
lines.en: Golden ki drags me gliding through the air.
Hair on end; even the wind goes around.
A notch faster than before.
One stride covers ten blocks.
The aura under me hums low.
I skim over the grass tops.

lines.zh: 身体还记得上一形态的节奏。
lines.en: This body still recalls the last form's rhythm.
Sparks dance by my legs.
I bank around the stone pillar.
This level of power is still climbing.
A blink and I'm elsewhere.
Keep up; I won't slow down.
Ki crackles around me.
I hold this power in check.

lines.zh: 再往上变就该到第三阶了。
lines.en: One more step and it's the third form.
A sphere of ki turns in my palm.
The tiles crack under my weight.
My breath is deep and long.
Waiting for the body to sync fully.
This hair is a nuisance.
I'm still holding back.
The air is pushed aside by my aura.
My muscles tense once, then ease.

lines.zh: 眼里看见的东西变慢了。
lines.en: Everything looks slower to my eyes.

lines.zh: 噪点一样的声音在耳边。
lines.en: A buzz of noise sits at my ear.
I calm down and draw the ki in.

lines.zh: 你现在看到的不是刚才的我。
lines.en: You're not looking at who I was.

lines.zh: 这一形态我没打算藏着。
lines.en: I wasn't going to hide this form.
Can you still stand steady?
My ki pushed you back.
Maybe think again.
This power is hard to rein in.
I'll try not to hurt you too badly.

lines.zh: 你眼里的我是不是模糊的？
lines.en: Do I look blurred to you?
Even at this level I'm not at full.
Is there still room to talk?
Don't swing wildly out of fear.
Step back and I'll ease off.
My patience is running short.
Listen closely; I'll say it once.
There's no malice in you.
My aura drowns out the sound.
Hold on; don't get blown over.

lines.zh: 骨头响了一声，还顶得住。
lines.en: My bones creak, but I'm still standing.
My aura flickered.
It hurts, but I held.
A thread of my ki scattered.
I grit my teeth and sink lower.
Half my arm went numb.
That cleared my head.
I don't intend to retreat.

lines.zh: 再来一次我就要认真了。
lines.en: One more and I get serious.
Eating costs too much in this form.
Wait until I change back.
I can smell it, but hold on.
Not enough for what I'm burning.
Hold it a bit farther from me.
Too much ki; I can't eat.
Set it down; I'll get it after I revert.
It would burn up if I ate now.
You really aren't afraid of me.
Fine; after this fight.
You hit the aura, not me.
I didn't shift an inch.
You were thrown back.
Your shoulder passes through my afterimage.
This shell of ki burns.
Two steps back; steady yourself.
My foot sank the ground in.
Our strengths don't match.
That moved the edge of my gi.
Try again and it ends the same.
Not in this form.
Too charged; this isn't right.
I'll answer properly once I revert.
I'm afraid of hurting you.
Wait until I cool down.
Standing that close is dangerous.
My mind is all battle.

lines.zh: 现在不是说这个的时候。
lines.en: This isn't the moment.
Step back first.
Another time, truly.
My aura flipped it up.
One grab and I have it.
I have to hold back the force.
Nearly crushed it.
This thing is too light.
I'll set it by your feet.
Don't make me pick it up again.
Check what it is first.
My aura scorched it.
Yours or mine?
You're already in my sight.
The moment the flow shifts, I arrive.
Afterimage fist first, to test.
Your opening is too easy to find.

lines.zh: 这种强度我期待很久了。
lines.en: I've wanted this level for a while.
Stand ready; I'm moving.
This punch comes with wind.
Three moves; I won't drag it out.
Your ki is pinned under mine.
I don't even need the Kamehameha.
I've cut off your retreat.

lines.zh: 眼神变了，你察觉到了吧。
lines.en: My eyes changed. You noticed?
Will one meteor combo do?
Coming from the left.
Don't watch only my hands.
Here we go.
I've memorized your rhythm.
I've picked up speed.

lines.zh: 你连着两次都往同一边躲。
lines.en: Twice now you've dodged the same way.
I press you from three sides.
I control the air currents here.
Your shoulder moves before your hand.
The afterimages will fool your eyes.
I can strike without closing in.
The gap is down to three steps.
You can't see my next step.
The barrage is ready.
I'll add another layer of pressure.
After this circle, I strike.
Meteor combo!
This fist carries ki.
Afterimage fist, behind you.
Three-hit chain; take it.
Aerial combo finisher.
The blast wave lifted you.
Knife hand chops your shoulder blade.
Don't block with your weapon.
I held back on that one.
Another hit and you'll be dazed.
My foot drops; the ground splits.
A ki blast bursts at your feet.
That combo is finished.

lines.zh: 速度太快，血迹都慢了半拍。
lines.en: So fast the blood lags behind.

lines.zh: 龟派气功的起手，就是这样。
lines.en: This is the Kamehameha's opening stance.
This one decides it.
The golden ki arrives before I do.
The air turns heavy and close.
This form came on its own.
A scorched ring marks the ground.
Let me draw the aura in a bit.
Who's nearby?
Gravity here feels light.
Hair standing up is odd.
I landed without a sound.
The nearby ki is all stirred up.
Let me look for an opponent.
This form will hold.
There's a hum in my ears.
Steady; the aura spills out.
The clouds above were blown apart.
I'm not at the third form yet.

lines.zh: 那就让我看看你的本事。
lines.en: Alright, begin.
Fire burns fiercer inside my aura.

lines.zh: 我从高空砸下来，地面凹了。
lines.en: I hit the ground from high up and dented it.
The water smothers my ki.
The explosion threw me back a dozen blocks.
Something pierced through the aura.
That spellwork tangled my ki.
Hunger makes the aura tremble.
Lightning scrambled my ki.
The void drains my ki away.
